title: Beam Hardening Artifact Simulator: Command-Line Tool
description: Beam Hardening Artifact Simulator built as a Command-line tool. A polychromatic X-ray beam loses low-energy photons first as it passes through tissue, so the beam hardens and the measured attenuation drops along thick paths. The result is cupping artifacts and dark bands near dense bone. Simulating mono- versus poly-energetic projections shows the artifact, and linearization correction shows the fix. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a Beam Hardening Artifact Simulator CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.

A resampling teacher that estimates the sampling distribution of a statistic by bootstrapping a synthetic dataset thousands of times, building percentile confidence intervals. It compares bootstrap intervals against the theoretical ones. The method is implemented from scratch. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Bootstrap Resampling Lab simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

Vessel centerlines are extracted by thinning a binary mask to its skeleton or by tracing ridges of the distance transform, then converting the result into a graph of branches and junctions. Pruning removes spurious twigs caused by boundary noise. Comparing the extracted graph against the known synthetic topology measures both geometric and topological accuracy. A synthetic scan analyzer that generates a seeded 2D scan with an anomalous blob, segments it by thresholding, and reports the blob centroid and size.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, random, math, statistics, collections
resume_bullet: Built a Centerline Extraction Simulator in Python with synthetic scan generation, threshold segmentation, and connected-component blob measurement.

title: Diffusion Tensor Simulator: Imaging_Analyzer
description: Diffusion Tensor Simulator built as a imaging_analyzer. Diffusion tensor imaging models water diffusion as a symmetric 3x3 matrix per voxel; its eigenvectors give fiber direction and eigenvalues yield fractional anisotropy and mean diffusivity. Simulating fiber bundles with known orientations produces tensor fields with ground-truth directions. Tractography algorithms can then be scored on how faithfully they follow the planted fibers. A synthetic scan analyzer that generates a seeded 2D scan with an anomalous blob, segments it by thresholding, and reports the blob centroid and size.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, random, math, statistics, collections
resume_bullet: Built a Diffusion Tensor Simulator in Python with synthetic scan generation, threshold segmentation, and connected-component blob measurement.

title: Motion Artifact Simulator: Imaging_Analyzer
description: Motion Artifact Simulator built as a imaging_analyzer. Patient motion during a scan corrupts the acquired signal, producing ghosting and blurring that follow the motion pattern. Simulating displacement fields of known amplitude on a clean phantom reproduces these artifacts faithfully. Motion-correction methods can then be validated by how well they recover the original image. A synthetic scan analyzer that generates a seeded 2D scan with an anomalous blob, segments it by thresholding, and reports the blob centroid and size.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, random, math, statistics, collections
resume_bullet: Built a Motion Artifact Simulator in Python with synthetic scan generation, threshold segmentation, and connected-component blob measurement.

title: MRI k-Space Simulator: Imaging_Analyzer
description: MRI k-Space Simulator built as a imaging_analyzer. K-space is the two-dimensional Fourier transform of the image, and MRI scanners sample it directly along trajectories like Cartesian lines or spirals. Undersampling accelerates scans but causes aliasing artifacts, while zero-filling trades resolution for speed. Simulating sampling patterns on a known phantom shows exactly how each choice degrades the image. A synthetic scan analyzer that generates a seeded 2D scan with an anomalous blob, segments it by thresholding, and reports the blob centroid and size.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, random, math, statistics, collections
resume_bullet: Built a MRI k-Space Simulator in Python with synthetic scan generation, threshold segmentation, and connected-component blob measurement.

Vascular trees grow by recursive branching where daughter radii follow Murray's law, keeping the cube of the parent radius equal to the sum of the daughters' cubes. Branching angles and length ratios control how natural the tree looks. The generated topology, with every bifurcation known, is ideal ground truth for vessel-tracing benchmarks. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
resume_bullet: Built a Synthetic Vessel Tree Generator simulator in Python (stdlib) implementing Euler integration of logistic growth with seeded parameters; demo runs end-to-end and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
